summary: Historical analogue constructed in 2026. META is used to study thesis repair and re-ignition after a previously valid avoid thesis. No contemporaneous TRQuant recommendation is asserted.
candidate_lessons: A correct avoid decision must be re-openable when dominant variables materially reverse.
Margin and FCF recovery provide stronger re-ignition evidence than price rebound alone.
Permanent exclusion after a thesis break can create missed-winner risk.
